title: Zesty Light German Chicken Skewers
description: A kid-friendly German dish featuring chicken skewers with a zesty and light flavor, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is halal-friendly and incorporates dried mint and a mirepoix base.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the white wine, dried mint, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a separate bowl, mix together the grated carrots, onion, and celery.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with the mirepoix base.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving to ensure food safety.
